name: Magical Rookie Manisha
original_name: マジカルルーキー　マニーシャ
source:
Main character Taro suddenly loses a part-time job right at the beginning of summer vacation, and he can't find a new one. On the street he encounters a tentacle monster, and a magical girl Manisha from another world saves his life. She calls Taro to help her transport all beasts attacking girls back into her world. Can protagonist survive with just 524 yen on his hands?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假剛開始，主角Taro打工的工作就突然沒了，又遲遲找不到新工作。一天，他在街上遭遇觸手怪物，幸得來自異世界的魔法少女瑪妮莎出手相救。她請Taro協助自己，將所有襲擊女孩的怪物送回她的世界。手頭只剩524日圓的主角，能撐得下去嗎？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
